title: Complaining politely in English: phrases, conversation, speaking | English Routine
description:
Complaining politely — الشكوى بأدب
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:44 The conversation
1:22 3 questions
1:47 Your turn: speak

Words
• I'm afraid there's a problem = للأسف في مشكلة
• wrong = غلط
• broken = مكسور / بايظ
• replace = يبدّل / يغيّر
• manager = المدير
• it's not acceptable = ده مش مقبول
• sort it out = يحلها / يظبطها
• apologize = يعتذر
